metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds a penny at the Rose door, Longshanks from the yard, three sentences on the tables, and Alleyn at the stair.

yesterday: You paid a penny and stood by a post, left of the stage. It was a fair house. Henslowe's eyes stayed on the boxes.
Alleyn played the first Edward in gilded mail, under the throne hung in June. He is already sure, and he fills the house like water in a jug.
On the tables: their king is all is, yours is all seems, five weeks.
He asked if you had come to count his inches. You said you had come to learn them. You saved the penny on the way home.
Tomorrow at two you are Egeon again, and after it the reckoning. The letter is still for Sunday.
